nowSource: Source: MFL fantasy points, this league's scoring · no finished week held yet
dynastySource: Source: the native value model · no model run read yet
how: On-field-now is points per game in this league's scoring over the finished weeks MFL has scored, counting only weeks in which the player has a score, ranked against every player at his position with a score this season. Dynasty value is the native value model's: his expected league points per game over this season and the ones after, later seasons discounted, from his record (draft capital, age, college, combine) and his seasons. A pick is valued in the same units by Pick Value v1: what the players typically taken at its slot are worth. Trades are not priced. Values only; this app moves nothing.
